info.title: Platform Core API
info.description: Enterprise Identity & Tenant Management API. Protected routes require Bearer JWT from Keycloak. Tenant context is derived from JWT only — never from client headers. Generated from NestJS source decorators (controllers + DTOs). Live interactive UI: GET /docs

bearer.description: Keycloak access token (staff platform-api / B2C platform-b2c)

isPatient.description: Derived B2C convenience: true if any non-archived tenant link has patient role
Patient role at this tenant (source of truth)

isCurrent.description: Matches JWT tenant_id of the current session

sourceTenantCustomerId.description: Tenant customer ID to merge into survivor (archived)

status.description: INVITED | PENDING_ACTIVATION | ACTIVE | SUSPENDED | LOCKED | DISABLED | DELETED

username.description: Dedicated PostgreSQL LOGIN role for this tenant database

status.description: PROVISIONING | ACTIVE | SUSPENDED | READ_ONLY | DEACTIVATING | ARCHIVED | DELETED | FAILED | LOCKED

keycloakRealm.description: DEPRECATED unused field. Platform uses one shared Keycloak realm; tenants have one or more Keycloak Organizations.

ownerIdentityId.description: Keycloak subject of the new owner

token.description: One-time plain-text token (not stored); always returned so it can be copied even if email send fails

emailSent.description: Whether the invitation email was sent (SMTP or Resend). Create still succeeds if send fails.

emailError.description: Short send error when emailSent is false

permissions.description: Permission catalog keys (resource:action) attached to this role

policies.description: Dynamic policy key/value pairs (mfaRequired, sessionLifetimeSeconds, etc.)

primary.description: Primary sign-in method for this user

phoneVerified.description: True only after successful phone OTP KYC (POST /users/me/identity/phone/verify-otp)

phoneE164.description: E.164 phone stored after OTP send/verify

search.description: Search userId, department, position, or roles
Search name, email, job title, or employee number

parentId.description: Filter by parent. Pass empty string for roots only.

tree.description: When true, returns flat tree list (all matching orgs)

repair.description: Apply automatic repairs for safe drift types (KC org create, membership sync)

denylistCallerToken.description: Also denylist the caller JWT (logout current device)

providerId.description: Keycloak provider id: google, microsoft, github, oidc, saml, …

config.description: Merged into existing config; empty secret keeps previous value

newOwnerIdentityId.description: Keycloak subject ID of the new owner

profile.description: User profile fields (personal, contact, professional). Partial merge.

redirectUri.description: Redirect URI after Keycloak required action

syncSessions.description: Sync soft device list from Keycloak sessions (default true)

serials.description: Required when product has serial tracking

markProductRecalled.description: When true (default for product-level), sets product/SKU status to RECALLED

txtName.description: DNS TXT record name to create

token.description: Value to place in the TXT record

databaseName.description: PostgreSQL database name for tenant pool

credentialsReference.description: Secret reference (env: TENANT_DB_PASSWORD). Defaults to TENANT_DB_PASSWORD.

ownerIdentityId.description: Initial tenant owner Keycloak subject id

bootstrapOrganization.description: Create a default Keycloak Organization in the shared realm and mirror it in the control plane (default true)

defaultOrganizationName.description: Display name for the default organization

defaultOrganizationSlug.description: Slug/alias for the default Keycloak Organization

refreshRequired.description: Client must exchange this for a refreshed JWT

defaultOrganizationId.description: Default organization created in the shared Keycloak realm (when bootstrap enabled)

hard.description: true = DROP DATABASE/ROLE; false = soft DELETED status only

modules.description: Effective module enablement for the tenant plan (+ feature flags)

capabilityMap.description: Flat map of effective permission codes for frontend gating

features.description: All resolved feature flags for the current context

navigationHints.description: Module keys that are enabled AND the user has at least one related permission
